newsitem.title: UK: Salomon reiterates buy on Poland's WBK.
newsitem.headline: Salomon reiterates buy on Poland's WBK.

text.p: Salomon Brothers has reiterated its buy recommendation on Poland's Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA in a note to investors.

"WBK shares rose 250 percent during 1996. While this took some kick out of the stock's valuation, we continue to regard WBK as one of Poland's best positioned banks and reiterate our buy recommendation," said analysts Jacek Dzierwa and Matthew Czepliewicz.
The stock was trading at 20.50 zlotys by 1137 GMT.

Salomon believes that the stock will benefit from a growing relationship with Allied Irish Banks Plc, which owns a 36 percent stake in WBK and has the option to buy an additional 23.9 percent from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, which will then trigger a takeover bid by AIB for WBK.
Salomon estimates that earnings per share at WBK will grow 21 percent in 1996 and 1997
